experiment: P0-19 Stage 0: top-k headroom (official-pose domain, exploratory)

pools.k4: the 4 returned beams of the num_beams=4 run (rank 0 = baseline top-1, by gate G1)
pools.k8: baseline top-1 (the stored P0-14 prediction) followed by the 8 returned beams of the num_beams=8 run

stage0.dedup: exact candidate text; first occurrence kept
stage0.concept_vocabulary: P0-14 Tier L (24 concepts), frozen matcher (build_concepts.py lemmas + concept_list_v1.csv match/forms)

metrics.C1_diversity: fraction of the 2209 clips whose pool contains at least one candidate with a Tier L concept set different from the top-1's
metrics.C2_recovery: number of the 498 missed cells (reference has Tier L concept c, stored top-1 does not) for which some pool candidate mentions c
metrics.C3_oracle: corpus chrF (sacrebleu corpus_chrf, default chrF2 char_order 6 word_order 0) of the per-clip oracle candidate minus corpus chrF of the stored top-1; oracle = argmax sentence_chrf against the single reference, ties -> lowest pool position

stage0.go_rule: GO iff all of C1, C2, C3 pass for k=4, or all pass for k=8; Stage 1 then uses the smallest passing k. Otherwise NO-GO: P0-19 stops at Stage 0, development NOT SUPPORTED, H19 stays sealed.

gates.G1_reproduction: num_beams=4 rank-0 text equals the stored P0-14 prediction and its trimmed token count equals the stored n_tokens, on 2209/2209 clips
gates.G2_determinism: an independent second run on the first 40 test_clean clips (manifest order) gives identical candidate count, order, token ids and texts for k=4 and k=8, and |seq_score difference| <= 1e-5
gates.G3_no_holdout: P0-16 guard passes on every clip id; open() tripwire installed in every Stage 0 process with no refusal; every archive member read is under test-pose-rtmpose-192/; run_meta of both runs records tripwire_installed
gates.G4_input_integrity: per-clip pose_sha256 equals the P0-14 stored value on 2209/2209; stored predictions sha256 prefix 0116a41a; candidate file covers exactly the 2209 test_clean ids in manifest order
gates.G5_label_reproduction: frozen matcher reproduces the manifest's 30 concept labels for all 2209 references, gives 888 Tier L mentions in the stored predictions, and exactly 498 missed Tier L cells

stage0.gate_failure: VOID: nothing interpreted, no re-run, no redefinition (P0-16 SANITY_GATE_POLICY section 5)
stage0.determinism_subset: first 40 test_clean clips in manifest order
descriptive_only: corpus BLEU-4 of top-1 and oracle
clips with oracle sentence chrF >= top-1 + 5
